project.name: E2E Abstract Motion Graphics
project.description: Tests pure motion graphics with geometric shapes and transitions — no characters, no text

source.text: Sound travels as a wave, an invisible ripple through the air around us.
When those waves reach your ear, your brain turns vibrations into music, into language, into meaning.

source.prompt: The concentric circles pulse outward in rhythm. The horizontal waveform lines oscillate up and down smoothly like a living equalizer. Subtle particle dust drifts in the background.

generate.prompt: Abstract motion graphics composition on a deep black background. Concentric circles in electric blue and cyan radiate outward from a central point, like ripples in water. Thin white horizontal lines cross the frame at varying heights, resembling an audio waveform. Minimalist, no text, high contrast.

source.prompt: The chaotic waves on the left flow rightward, transforming mid-frame into the structured gold hexagonal grid. The transition sweeps from left to right like a reveal.

generate.prompt: Abstract motion graphics on deep black background. Chaotic blue and cyan wave lines on the left side gradually converge and organize into a perfect geometric hexagonal grid pattern on the right side, glowing in warm gold and amber. A visual metaphor for disorder becoming order. Minimalist, high contrast, no text.
